content.title: When is Easter 2026? Publix will be closed. See list of open stores
content.text: March 26, 2026, 6:02 a.m. ETEaster Sunday will fall on April 5 in 2026, with its date determined annually by the lunar calendar.Major retailers like Target, Costco and Publix will be closed for the Easter holiday.Several stores, including Walmart, CVS and Whole Foods, are expected to remain open on Easter Sunday.Shoppers should verify the hours of their local stores as some may operate on a reduced schedule for the holiday.There's still just under two weeks to do all of your Easter shopping. But if you happen to forget a chocolate bunny for a basket, a hostess gift to bring to Easter brunch or an ingredient for your deviled eggs, there will still be a few grocery stores open on the holiday.Although some major stores like Publix and Target will be closed on Easter Sunday, there will be a few other grocery store chains to choose from on Easter Sunday.Here's which date Easter Sunday falls on in 2026 and a list of stores that will be open and closed on the holiday.When is Easter Sunday 2026?Easter Sunday will fall on April 5 in 2026. In 2025, Easter fell much later in the month, on April 20. Eastern Orthodox Easter will fall on Sunday, April 12, 2026.Is Publix open on Easter Sunday?No. Publix is never open on Easter Sunday.There are three holidays a year that all Publix locations close for: Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Day and Easter.What stores are open, closed on Easter Sunday 2026?While many stores close for Easter Sunday every year, there are a few that will remain open.Here's a list of retailers that will be closed on Easter:TargetCostcoSam's ClubAldiLowe'sTJ MaxxMarshall'sHomeGoodsHere's a list of retailers that will be open on Easter:Home DepotCVSWalgreensWhole FoodsSproutsWinn-DixieTrader Joe'sBJ's WholesaleWalmartNote that some of these retailers may have reduced hours at all or some of their locations due to the holiday. Check your nearest location's hours before you head to the store.How is the Easter date determined each year?Easter’s date changes because it is based on the lunar calendar, much like Lunar New Year. According to The Old Farmer’s Almanac, Easter Sunday always falls on the first full moon after the spring equinox.“While Christmas is fixed to a solar calendar (and near the winter solstice), Easter is based on the lunar cycles of the Jewish calendar,” the almanac says. “In the Christian religion, the Last Supper (the final meal Jesus shared with his apostles before his crucifixion) was a Passover feast. Because Easter is based on a lunar month (which is 29.5 days), the date of Easter can vary.”Lianna Norman and Samantha Neely are trending reporters for the USA TODAY NETWORK-Florida, covering pop culture, Florida wildlife, breaking news and more.
